integrity: The link computation uses the circle bundle of the canonical line bundle of the first Hirzebruch surface, the integral Gysin sequence, and the Smale--Barden classification. The global Euler characteristic uses only Wuebben's Hodge numbers for the smooth crepant resolution and additivity under replacing the exceptional Hirzebruch surface by the cone point.
scientific_limitations: The result computes the diffeomorphism type of the isolated singularity link and the ordinary topological Euler characteristic of the compact singular threefold. It does not determine the full ordinary cohomology ring, intersection cohomology, or mixed Hodge structure.
title: The \(\mathbb F_1\)-cone point has link \(S^2\times S^3\) and forces odd Euler characteristic
